name: Steps
purpose: Shows sequential progress through a named series of steps, optionally allowing jump selection.
scenarios: Jump back to a completed setup step

items.description: Ordered steps with value, label, and optional description.

onSelect.description: When provided, each step is a button that reports its value.

label.description: Accessible name of the steps landmark.

antiPatterns: Do not use Steps for peer section switching; use Tabs or Navbar.
Do not skip announcing the current step; aria-current=step is required.

keyboard: Tab moves through step buttons when interactive
Enter or Space activates a step button
a11y.focus: Interactive steps are buttons in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: The landmark has an accessible name; the current step uses aria-current=step.

responsive.strategy: Root is a query container. Compact stacks steps; tablet/desktop place them in a row. No viewport size media.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Row direction follows document lang/dir.
